edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender, establishing the privileged owner.
msg.sender indexes the wards mapping to decide authorization.
rely is gated by the auth modifier which reads wards[msg.sender].
deny is gated by the auth modifier which reads wards[msg.sender].
The wards[msg.sender] == 1 check controls whether rely executes.
The wards[msg.sender] == 1 check controls whether deny executes.
stop is only reachable when the auth modifier check passes.
start is only reachable when the auth modifier check passes.
change (source replacement) is only reachable when auth passes.
step (hop mutation) is only reachable when auth passes.
void is only reachable when auth passes.
kiss whitelisting is only reachable when auth passes.
diss whitelist removal is only reachable when auth passes.
era() returns the untrusted block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
pass() consumes era() (block.timestamp) to decide whether a poke is allowed.
era() output is passed to prev(), propagating the timestamp dependency.
poke requires pass() to return true, so the timestamp check gates state changes.
poke performs the external DSValue peek call before completing its feed updates.
The external call re-enters the untrusted source contract's peek implementation.
The auth-controlled src address is the target of the external call, so it determines the callee.
peek returns the stored val state variable.
peek returns the has validity flag alongside val.
DSValue.poke writes the val state variable.
DSValue.poke sets has = true after writing val.
The peeked value wut is migrated from nxt into the current feed via cur = nxt.
The peeked value wut is written into the next feed nxt.
The peeked validity flag ok decides whether nxt is overwritten.
poke assigns the previous nxt feed into cur.
poke writes the new Feed into nxt.
poke sets zzz = prev(era()) recording the update timestamp.
poke calls prev() to compute the hop-aligned timestamp.
pass() reads zzz to compute the elapsed interval.
pass() reads hop as the required minimum interval.
pass() calls OSM.add(zzz, hop) to compute the next allowed timestamp.
OSM.add computes z = x + y with only a wrapping require(z >= x) guard.
DSMath.add sums x and y, the arithmetic primitive needing overflow validation.
DSMath.mul multiplies x and y with a division-based overflow check.
Parameter x flows into the DSMath.add addition.
Parameter y flows into the DSMath.add addition.
wmul calls add on the intermediate product.
wmul calls mul on x and y.
peek returns cur.val and cur.has under the toll guard.
peep returns nxt.val and nxt.has under the toll guard.
read requires cur.has == 1 and returns cur.val.
prev() reads the hop interval to align the timestamp.
step writes the new hop interval value.
void resets cur to an empty Feed.
void resets nxt to an empty Feed.
void sets stopped = 1, halting further pokes.
stop sets the stopped flag.
start clears the stopped flag.
change replaces the trusted source address used for external calls.
Constructor grants ward status to the deployer.
Constructor stores the initial source address src_.
rely writes wards[usr] = 1.
deny writes wards[usr] = 0.
msg.sender indexes the bud whitelist checked by the toll modifier.
The owner_ parameter is written into the owner state variable.
The authority_ parameter is written into the authority state variable.
The ts parameter is written into the hop interval.
The ts parameter is consumed by the prev() rounding computation.
The a parameter is written into the bud whitelist mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is the sole write source of the owner state variable inside setOwner.
authority_ is the sole write source of the authority state variable inside setAuthority.
x is an operand consumed exclusively by the DSMath.add overflow-guarded sum.
y is an operand consumed exclusively by the DSMath.add overflow-guarded sum.
wut only carries the externally peeked value into the nxt feed within poke.
ok only gates the feed update inside poke.
ts is only used to write the hop state variable inside step.
ts is only used by the hop-alignment computation inside prev.
a is only used to set bud[a] = 1 inside kiss.
